title: How I built Wordz Survival, a word-spelling zombie defense game for iPhone, with AI
author: camhow13
selftext: I just released Wordz Survival, a free iPhone/iPad game where you drag across letter tiles to spell words and every word fires an arrow at an approaching zombie horde. I wanted to share how I built it with AI. Tools: I used Freebuff with a combination of Gemini and DeepSeek. Workflow: I was aiming for something close to the old Bookworm game, so I used prompts to get as near to that feel as I could and iterated from there. What was hard: timing the letter swipes so that you can link letters into words smoothly was the biggest problem. Getting the drag-to-link input to feel right took a lot of back and forth with the AI. The game has a pixel-art world with day/night ambience, a Daily Run (same board for everyone), Game Center leaderboards, and works offline. It is free, with an optional in-app purchase to unlock endless Full Mode. Happy to answer questions about the process, and feedback on difficulty and balance is very welcome. App Store link: [https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wordz-survival/id6821364577](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wordz-survival/id6821364577)
